title: Permission System
description: Agent checks permission policy before executing any tool

steps.content: Delete the old log files and install the new dependency
steps.annotation: Request includes a potentially dangerous operation (delete) and a safe one (install)

steps.content: I'll handle both requests. Let me check permissions first.
steps.annotation: Agent routes both actions through the permission gate
Model proposes a file deletion -- permission gate checks before execution

steps.content:
[Permission] Action: file_delete, Target: /var/log/old/*.log
Policy: ask (destructive file operation)
Prompting user for confirmation...
steps.annotation: The deny/mode/allow/ask pipeline reaches 'ask' for this destructive action

steps.content: Permission denied: destructive file operation requires user confirmation. Reason: rm -rf targets outside workspace.
steps.annotation: Permission result becomes visible context -- model sees why the action was blocked
Install command is auto-approved by the allow rule
Safe operation passes through the allow stage of the pipeline

steps.content: The dependency is installed. The file deletion was blocked because it targets files outside the workspace. Would you like me to delete only the workspace-local logs instead?
steps.annotation: Model reasons over the permission denial and proposes a safer alternative
